scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.typecheck:scripts: cd scripts && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint:scripts: cd scripts && npm ci && npx eslint src
scripts.test:scripts: cd scripts && npm ci && npx tsx --test src/__tests__/config-zod.test.ts

scripts/src/**/*.{ts}: bash -c 'cd scripts && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint src'
